items.title: Louis James Interview, 1959-05-25
items.q: Bach Hay played a most straighter. ... I know he got up pretty high.

ctx.x: I mean, if you heard him playing, you didn't know it was him, you'd know it was him. Oh, I know it was him, yeah. Yeah, yeah, yeah. Could you do that with several of the musicians? Any more of them that had their own style like that, besides Big Eye? Is Bach Hay quite different than Big Eye?
Bach Hay? Yeah. Bach Hay played a most straighter.
Did Bach Hay play up pretty high, way up above the coronet part?
